kpis.name: Rinvoq U.S. Market Exclusivity
kpis.explanation: Date by which no generic version of Rinvoq can enter the U.S. market.
kpis.description: In September 2025, AbbVie reached an agreement with all generic manufacturers, pushing the entry of Rinvoq generics in the United States to April 2037, subject to pediatric exclusivity.

kpis.name: Worldwide Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue — total sales generated over the period.
kpis.description: Worldwide net revenue totaled $61.2 billion in 2025, up 9% year-on-year, on both a reported basis and constant currency basis.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin stood at 24.7% in 2025, calculated from operating income of $15.1 billion on revenue of $61.2 billion.

kpis.name: Research and Development Expenses
kpis.description: The exact amount of R&D expenses is not specifically detailed in the 10-K. However, implicit expenses include amortization of intangible assets ($7.4B), change in fair value of contingent considerations ($6.5B) and acquisition expenses ($276M), indicating a strong R&D commitment to maintain a pipeline of 90 programs, 60 of which in mid- or late-stage development.
kpis.signal: Massive investment in a rich pipeline of 90 programs in development.

kpis.name: Cash Flow from Operations
kpis.explanation: Cash generated by the company's core activities.
kpis.description: Operating cash flows reached $19.0 billion in 2025, supporting R&D investments, acquisitions and the dividend.

kpis.name: R&D Pipeline Programs
kpis.explanation: Total number of drugs, devices or indications in development.
kpis.description: AbbVie's pipeline includes approximately 90 programs, of which about 60 are in mid- or late-stage development, covering immunology, neurological disorders, oncology, aesthetics and obesity.

company_description: AbbVie Inc., a research-based biopharmaceutical company, engages in the research and development, manufacturing, commercializing, and sale of medicines and therapies worldwide. The company offers Skyrizi to treat autoimmune diseases; Rinvoq to treat inflammatory diseases; Imbruvica for the treatment of adult patients with blood cancers; Venclexta to treat blood cancers; Elahere to treat various cancer; and Epkinly to treat lymphoma; and Emrelis for the treatment of lung cancer. It also provides facial injectables, plastics and regenerative medicine, body contouring, and skincare products; botox Cosmetic for the treatment of glabellar lines, crow's feet, forehead lines, and platysma bands; Juvederm Collection to treat volume loss in the temples, undereye, cheeks, chin, lips and lower face; Vraylar to treat schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and depressive disorder; Duodopa to treat Parkinson's disease; Ubrelvy to treat migraine; Qulipta for episodic and chronic migraine; and Vyalev for the treatment of motor fluctuations, as well as Botox Therapeutic to treat chronic migraine, overactive bladder, spasticity, cervical dystonia, and other conditions.
